data.long_meaning: The name Finley is of Irish origin, derived from the Gaelic words 'Finne' and 'leann', which mean 'fair' and 'handsome', respectively. This name was often given to children who were considered beautiful or attractive. The name Finley carries the meaning “Fair, Handsome” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Finley usually hope their child will grow to embody fair, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.long_meaning: Finley is a Scottish masculine given name of Gaelic origin, meaning white, fair, or noble. It is believed to have originated from the Gaelic word finl, which means fair or white. The name Finley has become popular in Scotland and has also been used in other countries. It is considered a strong and handsome name for a boy. In the Bible, there is no direct reference to the name Finley, but it is associated with the qualities of nobility and purity. In Christian tradition, the name Finley is seen as a symbol of spiritual purity and innocence. People with the name Finley are often seen as confident, charming, and adventurous.
